changes: TheoryDeveloper has a direct model-owned report_theory_gap tool. It requires a prior observation, terminates as BLOCKED, stores workspace evidence once by reference, and never becomes proof evidence.

A runtime-owned formal_target_authoring_required contract now controls TheoryDeveloper formalization artifacts. Optional and advisory research tasks need not invent Lean handoffs; capability_eval and required formal tasks still fail closed, and an Architect plan cannot lower that gate.

The content-level validator no longer accepts theory by parsing a PASS prefix. PASS, FAIL, and INCONCLUSIVE self-checks remain visible for exploration and independent review rather than being relabeled by a Python rule.

Scientific coding models may execute exact current source once after another bound dependency changes. The model chooses this diagnostic action; runtime neither edits source nor infers defect ownership.

Metric author and independent reviewer prompts now align declared returned values and numeric gates explicitly. Runtime still applies the frozen model-authored contract without statistical transformations.
Theory revision budget state survives Architect replanning and remains scoped to one fresh question runtime.

Product research evaluation and strict S13 formal-capability evaluation are separate authorities. Optional formal gaps cannot erase accepted non-formal evidence, while S13 still requires exact source-theorem kernel closure.

A data-only L0-L6 benchmark ladder stages focused known results, exact replication, paper-to-code reproduction, hidden rederivation, historical rediscovery, near-frontier extension, and open-problem evidence audits. Candidate gold remains inactive and outside runtime/RAG.
